steps.en: Load a playlist from a URL, a file path, or a string you already have
steps.zh: 从 URL、文件路径或手头的字符串加载播放列表

steps.en: Fetches the text and remembers its base URI so relative segment paths resolve
steps.zh: 取回文本，记下基准地址，让相对的分片路径能解析

steps.en: Parses every tag into typed objects: segments, variant streams, keys, ad cue markers
steps.zh: 把每个标签解析成带类型的对象：分片、多码率子流、密钥、广告插入标记

steps.en: Read or change the fields your job is about
steps.zh: 读取或改动你关心的字段

steps.en: Write the result back out to a string or a file
steps.zh: 把结果写回字符串或文件

steps.en: Serializes the object model back into HLS playlist text
steps.zh: 把对象模型重新序列化成 HLS 播放列表文本

value.en: You edit an HLS manifest as Python objects instead of regexing #EXT tags line by line
value.zh: 改 HLS 清单就是改 Python 对象，不用再逐行正则匹配 #EXT 标签

sources: https://github.com/globocom/m3u8/blob/master/m3u8/__init__.py (load: URL via http_client.download, else file; base_uri set) + m3u8/httpclient.py (urllib, gzip-aware)
